name: WorldSeed 3D
summary: A planet you can sculpt in the browser.
brief: Give people a way to shape a planet and explore its atmosphere directly in a web browser.
build: I built the terrain with procedural noise in a vertex shader. A separate shader handles light scattering through the atmosphere, so the landscape and the light can change independently as you orbit the planet.
detail: Touch controls let visitors orbit the same scene on a phone. Moving the terrain calculations onto the GPU keeps the interface free to respond to input.
alt: WorldSeed planet editor with a sunlit globe and terrain controls

name: DigiVolt
summary: A live dispatch workspace for electric fleets.
role: Senior web developer and UI architect
brief: Give transit operators one place to follow vehicles, monitor batteries and coordinate electric shuttles and tricycles.
build: I built the dispatch interface around the map. A lightweight WebSocket connection delivers position updates, battery readings and arrival estimates without reloading the dashboard.
detail: The design had to work on low-bandwidth connections. Keeping changing telemetry separate from the rest of the interface lets dispatchers keep their place while fleet data updates.
alt: DigiVolt fleet dispatch interface showing live routes and vehicle status

name: DigiNorth
summary: One platform for Northern Nigeria’s innovation programmes.
brief: Connect hackathons, talent academies and startup programmes across the 19 states of Northern Nigeria.
build: I structured the platform as 13 modules backed by PostgreSQL. Role-based access gives programme teams the tools they need to manage their own cohorts and submissions.
detail: Organisers can admit a cohort, review a project and manage a state delegation from the same system.
alt: DigiNorth programme management dashboard displayed on a desktop monitor

name: Everything Kaduna
summary: A searchable directory of Kaduna businesses.
brief: Help people find local businesses across Kaduna and give merchants a way to create a verified listing.
build: I connected the React interface to a MySQL directory through tRPC and Drizzle ORM. A shared type system keeps the search results and listing records in step.
detail: The merchant onboarding flow includes verification, so the directory can distinguish a reviewed listing from a newly submitted one.
alt: Everything Kaduna map and business listings

name: NATI Aviation
summary: Digital admissions for an aviation training institute.
brief: Move course discovery, application intake and admissions documents into one coherent experience for prospective aviation students.
build: I designed the course catalogue and built a responsive admissions flow. Structured forms guide applicants through their details and document submissions.
detail: The portal connects course information to the application process so a prospective student can move directly from reading a syllabus to applying.
alt: NATI aviation training website with course listings

name: Winepress Media
summary: Publishing infrastructure and connected retail operations.
role: Senior web developer and systems architect
brief: Support sudden peaks in readership while giving the operations team consistent inventory and payroll data across retail outlets.
build: I added Redis-backed caching to the publishing stack and built REST data pipelines for the retail systems. The public reading experience and internal reconciliation tools each serve a different workload.
detail: Caching frequently requested content reduces repeated work on the publishing servers when a story attracts a surge of readers.
alt: Winepress editorial homepage and article layouts
